entities.name: Everlorne
entities.description: A land ruled by the wizard Noranda-Zang, with juniper and holly forests, yellow-green plains and a stone fortress.

entities.name: Kartya
entities.description: An island on an unknown plane, home of the planeswalker Rafthrasa.

entities.name: Rafthrasa
entities.description: Planeswalker who wanted to live on Kartya as a mortal farmer.

entities.name: Kell Phir
entities.description: A place with poppy dens that Elspeth has been to.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Planeswalker who has been to Kell Phir and Zarnic.

entities.name: Valley of Echoes

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Found a scroll in the Valley of Echoes that he could read.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Could not read the scroll Karn found.

entities.name: Vex

entities.name: Zarnic
